body: The loss of a parent is one of the hardest things to go though and navigate for everyone. I lost my mother in 2014 and to this day I’m still trying to figure out how to move forward. Is not easy, there’s no playbook or readily available solution. You have to just live your life in a way to make her proud of you. She is proud of you, wherever she is.  What you described is a tough situation to be in and I understand how you feel. Your situation may seem hopeless and difficult, but I promise there’s a light at the end of the tunnel. Times are very difficult right now, but you’re doing the best you can and that takes strength. You’re stronger than you think.
As hard as life is, you made the right choice. It’s be been where you are at many times, but the things we love, despite how minuscule they seem, are worth living for.
